summary: The issuer reported voting results from an extraordinary general meeting held August 10, 2026 (Hong Kong time). Shareholders approved three resolutions: (1) an increase in authorized share capital from 50,000,000 to 5,000,000,000 shares; (2) creation of Class A (one vote each) and Class B (fifty votes each) shares with a repurchase-and-reissuance of founder shares into Class B shares, and adoption of new articles; (3) a 6-for-1 share consolidation effective October 7, 2026, with fractional shares rounded up. All resolutions passed with over 99% support. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation; watch for post-consolidation trading and voting control concentration in Class B holders.
